summary: Verified the new warehouse LOCATION feature added to /app/backend/routes/warehouse.py. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse.py from 33 to 40 tests (added 7 targeted tests in a new TestWarehouseLocation class covering all 7 review scenarios: quick-add saves warehouse_location, search returns it on product row + on each batch, batch without location inherits product default, explicit location overrides default, PUT /batches/{id} updates location, PUT /products/{id}/location updates product default, and permission gate 403 for staff without warehouse_manage). All 40 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: warehouse.py L708 — trims whitespace on new_loc but does not enforce non-empty. Passing warehouse_location='' via PUT /products/{id}/location silently clears the default. This is intentional per the docstring but worth documenting on the frontend so users aren't surprised when submitting a blank field wipes their bay.

warehouse.py L765-767 — inheritance logic uses `(payload.location or '').strip()` then falls back to product.warehouse_location. A batch created with location='   ' (whitespace-only) will inherit the product default. Reasonable behavior but non-obvious; consider explicit null check vs empty-string check if you want to allow 'intentionally blank' batches on products that have defaults.

warehouse.py L867-868 — PUT /batches/{id} location update: `if payload.location is not None: updates['location'] = payload.location.strip()`. This means a client can set location back to empty string, but cannot use the inheritance fallback on update (only on create). Consistent with the spec that inheritance is a create-time convenience, but flag it in the frontend so 'clear location' vs 'reset to default' are distinguishable.

warehouse.py L716-725 — the audit log for set_product_default_location writes before/after warehouse_location correctly, but does NOT resync existing batches. This matches the docstring intent ('does NOT retroactively move existing batches'), but if a user renames a rack (e.g. 'Rack A3-12' → 'Rack A3-12b') the batches on that rack still show the old string. Consider surfacing this in the UI (e.g. 'This will only affect NEW batches').

success_rate.frontend: N/A — frontend testing skipped per request

seed_data_creation: Per pytest run a new location-tagged product is quick-added with SKU TEST-WH-LOC-<run_id> (default location 'Rack A3-12', later updated to 'Rack B1-05') plus two batches (LOC-INHERIT-<run_id>, LOC-EXPLICIT-<run_id>). No product delete endpoint exists on warehouse router — records remain in DB. Unique run-id prevents cross-run collisions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Total warehouse pytest count is now 40 (33 batch/stock + 7 new location). To re-run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<preview_url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_warehouse.py -v. The new TestWarehouseLocation class shares the test_staff fixture (module-scoped) with earlier permission-gate classes, so the 403 test at the end of the location class runs AFTER TestBatchPermissionGates has already reset the staff's overrides — a defensive reset is done inside the test itself.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature works as specified end-to-end. All 7 review scenarios verified.
